area.bookingInfo: WeGo Link is an Uber voucher program. Download the reusable WeGo Link voucher, then book your ride in the Uber app at a discounted rate. South Nashville rides are free until further notice. For an accessible vehicle or to pay with cash, book with Mobility Solutions (615-844-3399) or zTrip (629-294-4447).
area.tripRules: All trips must take place within one service zone and start and end at one of its designated stops.

notes: Zones are the 19 rows of the WeGoLink_Zones layer with TrnsfrLoc1 set; the other rows are small transfer-stop polygons and are left out. The layer service is named WeGo_Link_Eligibility because the WeGo Link page uses it as the map to check whether a trip is eligible, not as a rider rule. Zone names come from the layer Name field; the WeGo Link page calls three of them Bordeaux/Buena Vista, Brick Church Pike and East Thompson Lane. Designated stops are left out because no stop layer is given, and the stop lists on the page and in the layer do not fully agree. No hours are published, so zones draw faded; re-check the page and zone sheets for hours. A fall 2022 FAQ said Uber riders must be 18 or older and riders 17 or younger may use Mobility Solutions; the current FAQ does not say this, so no eligibility is set. Three zones use the WeGo Link page names (Bordeaux/Buena Vista, Brick Church Pike, East Thompson Lane), not the layer's shorter names.
